claims.statement: Material tangent validation across 18 UMAT examples; twelve models show zero difference, three differ because the original approximates some derivative terms, and one (spin_elas_def.f) by too much, traced to an error in the original UMAT.

Internal Jacobian verification. Nineteen entries were checked, fourteen exactly and five within tolerance, across the members of the tangent-verification set that carry out a nonlinear solve inside the material update.
Higher-order verification across representative nonlinear models: order 1 against analytical derivatives, orders 2-4 against finite-difference references.
J2 verification of the exported sensitivity arrays against centred finite differences; largest difference 5.98e-11 over 24 stress-sensitivity entries and 1.37e-10 over 4 state-sensitivity entries.

Stress-sensitivity verification across 18 models and 76 parameter directions against centred finite differences; largest difference 1.6e-7 for the crystal-plasticity model with twelve slip systems, the rest between 1e-11 and 1e-9.
Corpus discovery, transformation and verification over publicly available UMAT sources.

Generality checked beyond the single J2 model on a further 18 material models covering elasticity, plasticity, viscoplasticity, damage, crystal plasticity, Cosserat, hyperelastic, viscoelastic and thermoelastic behaviour.
